vroom: grabaciones locales con copia en: vroom: local recordings with a copy in Cloudflare R2 vroom list recordings, newest first vroom sync uploads what is pending and frees expired local copies vroom upload ... | --pending uploads recordings to R2 (resumes interrupted ones) vroom share [--before-upload] link to share vroom stream-url temporary URL to play from R2 vroom download downloads the video of a recording that is only in R2 vroom restore rebuilds the library from R2 (new computer) vroom rename vroom move <id> [folder/sub] moves to a folder (no folder: to the top level) vroom folders lists the folders vroom folder create <path> | rename <path> <new> | delete [--recordings [--keep-cloud]] <path> (when deleting, recordings move to the folder above; with --recordings they are deleted, from R2 too unless --keep-cloud) vroom transcribe <id>... | --missing [--language es] [--model path.bin] captions with Whisper, locally (uses MacWhisper's models) vroom title <id>... | --missing [--force] automatic title with Claude from the captions vroom free <id> deletes the local video of a recording already uploaded vroom delete <id> [--keep-cloud] deletes the recording (also from R2, unless --keep-cloud) vroom config shows the configuration vroom config r2 --account-id <id> --bucket <b> --access-key-id <k> [--public-url <u>] [--prefix <p>] [--jurisdiction eu] (the secret is read from stdin) vroom config set <key> <value> library, auto_upload, keep_local_days vroom config anthropic [--clear] Anthropic key for automatic titles (from stdin) vroom check tests the connection to R2 vroom loom import [--no-upload] [--free-local] [--limit N] imports your Loom videos (connect.sid cookie on stdin or in VROOM_LOOM_COOKIE) vroom loom list lists what would be imported For the app: new [--title t] [--folder f], finalize <id> --duration s --width w --height h, recover, version. --json on any command prints JSON events, one per line.
